children: UiPath, Inc. reported quarterly results for 2026 with revenue of $410.26M, net income of $36.09M and diluted EPS of $0.07, each above the prior-year quarter as the company continued subscription-led growth and customer expansion.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share, diluted”.
Year-to-date revenue reached $828.6M, up 15% year-over-year; the quarter’s revenue of $410.3M rose 13% YoY, with roughly 72% of growth driven by expansion within existing customers.
Annual recurring revenue (ARR) was $1.9377B, up 12% YoY, and dollar-based net retention was about 109%, indicating continued customer expansion.

Growth was led by subscription services and licenses, each up 14% year-to-date, while increasing SaaS and hosting usage raised third-party subcontractor and hosting costs and modestly compressed gross margins (around 80–81%).
Strategic actions included completion of WorkFusion acquisition payments and continued R&D investment in AI and agentic automation; impacts from FY25 restructuring are subsiding.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
